reason: My bank app already shows my history, so I don't see what this adds beyond it. I'd maybe try the free trial to see, but I'm not paying for slip reading I could just look up in my banking app.
objection: I'll set up the Shortcut, use it for a couple of weeks, and then stop like I did with the last budget app. The setup is the easy part; keeping it going is what I never managed.
would_change_my_mind: A monthly breakdown by category that my bank app doesn't give me, built automatically from my slips and card statement, that I actually kept using for a full month during the trial.
